sources.assessment: Live refetch confirms shared MAPNUM/PARCEL_ID on distinct PARCEL components 103 and 103.18 and different source types. Official PVA map-number identity definition does not explain this contradiction or lifecycle. County key is unsafe; no arbitrary union applied. City official zoning map supplies no cadastral alternate; same-name public hosted parcel layer is Illinois and rejected.
